idle: Twenty-five dollars a game. And the experience. Mostly the experience.
good_ice: Ice is good. Nobody can blame the ice. Which means they'll blame me.
bad_ice: Kids are tripping on that rut. That's not a penalty. That's the rink.
wet_ice: Is it okay to delay the game for wet ice? It is. I checked. Twice.
cold: The ref room's freezing. My whistle stuck to my lip once.
hungry: Is it okay if I get fries? Between periods? Is that allowed?
long_line: I'll just wait. I'm good at waiting. I'm fifteen.
bored: U9 games where nobody yells. Best games ever.
goal: Good goal! I mean. Goal. Officially.
greet_owner: Oh. Hi. Hello. Sir. Ma'am. Owner.
Hi! Is it okay that I'm here early?
leaving_happy: Nobody yelled. Well, one dad. But quietly.
leaving_angry: Maybe I'll just ref in Harlow Falls.

minor_hockey: That's a TRIP. (His voice cracks.) That's a trip.
Sir, please step back from the glass.
tournament: Four games today. I have four whistles. Well, one whistle. Four times.

first.say: Oh! Hi. I'm Brody. I ref minor hockey. Level 1. I'm fifteen, but the rules are the same for everyone, so that's fine.

options.text: Fifteen and reffing? Good for you.

first_kind.say: Thanks. Marcel says it gets easier. Marcel says a lot of things. He's very calm about it.

first_young.say: That's what the dads say. Rule 2.1 doesn't have an age in it. I checked. (His voice cracks on 'checked'.)

options.text: I'm sorry, Brody. I'll sort it.

say: I've got the U9s next. Nobody yells at U9s. Usually.
Is that Mr. Saucier at the glass? Is it? Okay. Okay.

backed.say: You said you'd back me. Mr. Saucier yelled on Saturday and I thought about that, and I didn't look at him. I just called it. It felt good.

say: Do you need me? I'm not on for twenty minutes.

options.text: What games do you like best?
How do you handle the yelling?
If a parent gives you trouble, I've got your back.

job.say: Twenty-five dollars a game. I'm saving for a car. Also the experience. Mom says the experience is the main thing. Mom doesn't ref.

events.say: U9 games where nobody yells. Tournaments are hard but you get four games. And I watch the Mallards. I want to ref high school next year.

gossip.say: Marcel says don't look at the glass. Mrs. Pettigrew says she'll handle the parents. And Mr. Saucier says I'm blind. I'm not. I have very good eyes. I had them tested.

rink.say: The ref room's a closet. It's cold. There's one hook and Marcel gets it, which is fair. I put my coat on a broom.

rink_better.say: There's a heater! And a chair! I sat on the chair. Is that okay? Nell said it was okay.

back.say: Really? Like, if Mr. Saucier yells, you'd talk to him?

options.text: I'll talk to him. You call the game.

do.note: Told Brody Sauve you'd back him against parents at the glass.

back_yes.say: Okay. Okay! That's. Thank you. (His voice cracks, but in a good way.)

say: I'll go check the nets. Twice.
